# Native rasterizer notices

The Cargo lockfiles pin fontdue 0.9.3 and ttf-parser 0.21.1. The original notices
copied from those published source packages are retained here:

- [fontdue MIT](fontdue-MIT.txt)
- [fontdue libm notice](fontdue-libm.txt)
- [fontdue Unicode notice](fontdue-unicode.txt)
- [ttf-parser MIT](ttf-parser-MIT.txt)

Sources: [fontdue 0.9.3](https://crates.io/crates/fontdue/0.9.3),
[ttf-parser 0.21.1](https://crates.io/crates/ttf-parser/0.21.1).
Font assets carry their own [unchanged notices](../fonts/LICENSE).
